Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted both datasets when finalizing the answer: (1) they replaced Shanghai’s permanent resident population (24.8745 million) with the household-registered subcomponent (14.8017 million), and (2) they misread Hanggin Rear Banner’s figure of 20.87 as 20.87 million instead of recognizing the common Chinese unit “万人” (ten-thousands), which corresponds to about 208,700 people. This unit/metric confusion led to the incorrect conclusion that Hanggin Rear Banner’s population exceeds Shanghai’s.
